claude_instructions.claim: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md directly as the repository-level project instruction file from v2.1.277, but only when no CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, or CLAUDE.local.md counts in the working directory or above it; a root CLAUDE.md containing @AGENTS.md is the documented compatibility bridge for sessions that cannot read AGENTS.md directly.

claude_agents_md_native_20260919.claim: Claude Code 2.1.277 on this machine, asked via `claude -p --model haiku --max-turns 1` in a fresh `git init` directory to quote any probe token in its project instructions, answered KAOLA-AGENTS-ONLY-7731 when only AGENTS.md carried it, and answered KAOLA-CLAUDE-OVERLAY-4402 only (not KAOLA-AGENTS-ONLY-7731) once a CLAUDE.md carrying KAOLA-CLAUDE-OVERLAY-4402 with no import sat beside the same AGENTS.md. Any repository CLAUDE.md shadows AGENTS.md unless it imports it; this repository therefore ships none.

codex_instructions.claim: AGENTS.md is discovered from repository root to the current working directory.

opencode_instructions.claim: Project and global AGENTS.md files are supported directly.

kimi_instructions.claim: AGENTS.md files are loaded from global and project scopes.

kimi_global_named_profile_20260827.claim: Kimi Code 0.38.0 selected the user-global kaola-role-implementer profile from each of two unrelated empty Git repositories with no project Kimi or .agents catalog. Both read-only prompt-mode calls returned the exact requested token and left the repositories empty.

grok_instructions.claim: AGENTS.md project rules are loaded directly from repository root to the current directory.

cursor_instructions.claim: Root and nested AGENTS.md files are supported directly.

cursor_cloud_task_catalog.claim: Cursor Cloud Agent Task catalogs stayed built-in-only for Kaola custom types. A consumer with 14 git-tracked project profiles still exposed generalPurpose, explore, cursor-guide, bugbot, security-review, and best-of-n-runner; omit-model and inherit generalPurpose succeeded; cursor-grok-4.6-high was resolver-rejected. A later producer Cloud parent also lacked Kaola names and additionally exposed explore, computerUse, and videoReview.

cursor_cli_named_profile_20260827.claim: Authenticated standalone Cursor CLI build 2026.08.25-3e8eec8 discovered an explicit project materialization and dispatched the exact custom implementer type. The parent omitted a model override; the Task carrier resolved cursor-grok-4.6-medium and the child returned the requested read-only probe token. Exact binding is verified from `providerOptions.cursor.modelName` provider evidence when the host exposes it; a TUI child transcript alone is insufficient, and internal `subagentType.custom.name` is provider encoding, not controller call shape.

cursor_app_local_named_profile_20260827.claim: Cursor App 3.17.21 local IDE Agent exposed all 14 project Kaola types and successfully dispatched exact implementer without repository mutation. The UI did not expose the selected child model, effort, or profile-source carrier.

cursor_cloud_preboot_catalog_20260827.claim: Negative control: a brand-new App-started Cloud chat selected branch probe/cursor-cloud-1041-20260827a at commit ead40c2741f4cae7e0a0cb473bba8a8a4a80c7a6, where all 14 project Cursor profiles were committed before the Agent launch but were not installed by the Cloud environment Build. Its live Task enum remained built-in-only: generalPurpose, explore, computerUse, videoReview, cursor-guide, bugbot, security-review, and best-of-n-runner; exact implementer was absent and no substitute was dispatched. A checked-in catalog alone is not equivalent to installing the selected Cloud environment before snapshot.

cursor_cloud_saved_environment_20260827.claim: Historical positive control: Cursor dashboard Build bld-20260827-aaac14bf-e980-4d1a-9600-e8b3fb2e031e exposed all 14 Kaola names and exact implementer, but its released-10.0.1 global installer also wrote an ambient project catalog. Clean Build bld-20260827-1fd163c3-a8f2-475d-9603-7da988673ee3 later falsified user-global discovery alone: the live Task enum stayed built-in-only despite 14 current user files. These controls require the final environment-setup Build to install both its remote machine authority and its selected repository before snapshot.

cursor_cloud_environment_setup_20260828.claim: Cursor Cloud environment setup confirmed candidate 101250f293a5439ed73e8ee2127c7501fba9e883, installed the remote machine authority and explicitly materialized the selected repository, and passed current receipt, authority-binding, 14-agent, collision, and byte-idempotence checks. The user manually saved exact Build bld-20260827-56284e4a-bc0c-4cb6-b873-a48d180693e2. New top-level same-repository parent bc-3e6bd3bd-f310-47cd-a9cb-358cf802f16d visibly used that Build, exposed nine native plus all 14 Kaola Task types, and exact implementer child bc-7d00ddad-23f3-5e69-8f9a-1c326b051a49 returned PROBE_OK_CURSOR_CLOUD_FINAL_SAVED_REPO_IMPLEMENTER with no substitute or per-call model override. Child model and profile-source carriers remained unobservable. Cloud requires installation in its environment setup, a tested and user-saved Build, then a new top-level Agent in the same repository; local install never deploys Cloud.

zcode_instructions.claim: User-global and workspace-root AGENTS.md files are supported directly.

zcode_native_skill_20260919.claim: ZCode 3.12.3 + GLM-5.3 via the KPR ACP adapter 0.3.3: workspace `.zcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (frontmatter `name:` + `description:`) is natively discovered, and `/<name>` produces an ACP `tool_call title=Skill` (pending to in_progress to completed) that loads the body, unique-marker verified; `/$<name>` also routes natively. A real `/compact` completes, and a previously-uninvoked Skill and a re-invoked Skill both emit fresh `Skill` tool calls after it. `~/.zcode/skills/` user scope resolves the same way. KPR #75 measured that ZCode's AGENTS.md prefix survives compaction. ACP exposes no `available_commands_update`; real GLM 1M auto-compact was not run.

devin_f1.claim: F1: `devin doctor --json` reported loaded profiles from user `~/.config/devin/agents/` and project `.devin/agents/`; `.claude/agents/` files were not counted.

devin_f2.claim: F2: A fresh `devin -p` session listed probe profiles from `.devin/agents/` plus built-ins `subagent_explore` and `subagent_general`; project `.claude/agents/*.md` did not appear. Parent reported `MODEL: Adaptive` and export showed `agent.model_name = Adaptive` with `generation_model = kimi-k2-7`.

devin_f3.claim: F3: Exact named foreground dispatch succeeded for probe profiles and `subagent_general` with no repository mutation; every parent step resolved to `generation_model = kimi-k2-7`.

devin_f4.claim: F4: Unpinned custom child profiles showed `You are powered by Subagent Default.`; `model: adaptive` showed `You are powered by Adaptive.`; `model: inherit` passed through as a literal model name (do not emit); `subagent_general` inherited the parent.

devin_f5.claim: F5: Subagent tray showed router labels (`Adaptive`, `Subagent Default`) rather than resolved model names.

devin_f6.claim: F6: A `subagent_general` child reported `PROFILES: NONE`, confirming `run_subagent` is unavailable inside a child and the default nesting depth is one.

devin_f7.claim: F7: A write-capable profile running in the background with no prior write grant was denied, leaving the target file uncreated; background agents automatically deny tools requiring approval.

devin_f8.claim: F8: Hook discovery loaded providers including `devin`, `agents_standard`, `cursor`, `windsurf`, `claude`, `opencode`, `zed`, `copilot` and loaded the Kaola Claude `SessionStart` hook from `~/.claude/settings.json` into Devin sessions (cross-host leak #1057).

devin_f9.claim: F9: The `SessionStart` hook fired with stdin containing `hook_event_name=SessionStart` and `source=startup`; its `additionalContext` reached the model verbatim.

devin_f10.claim: F10: A `PostCompaction` hook fired after `/compact` but its `additionalContext` did not reach the model, consistent with docs limiting `additionalContext` to `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, and `PostToolUse`.

devin_f11.claim: F11: After `/compact` the model context dropped `SessionStart` context, AGENTS.md blocks, and imported `.cursor`/`.claude`/`.windsurf` rules; `KW-COMPACT-RECOVERY-START` went from present to absent.

devin_f12.claim: F12: A `UserPromptSubmit` hook after compaction injected `additionalContext` that was quoted by the model, making it the only deterministic post-compaction context carrier measured.

devin_f13.claim: F13: A profile created after session start failed with `Subagent failed to start`, byte-identical to an unknown name; the catalog is fixed at session start.

devin_f14.claim: F14: `devin doctor` is present in this build and does not validate `model` values; it accepted both `adaptive` and `inherit`.

droid_agents_md.claim: AGENTS.md (with CLAUDE.md as a compatibility entry point) is discovered from the current directory up through the repository root, and personally from ~/.factory/, ~/.agents/, and ~/.agent/ if present.

droid_skills.claim: A skill is a directory whose SKILL.md entry point carries a name and description in its frontmatter; skills are discovered from project .factory/skills/ and personal ~/.factory/skills/, are user-invocable (/name) and model-invocable by default, and the invoked skill's SKILL.md body is injected into context.

droid_commands.claim: A .factory/commands/<name>.md file registers a custom slash command; this edition ships skills, not commands, so the surface stays uninstrumented.

droid_subagents.claim: Custom droids are authored as markdown in .factory/droids/ and ~/.factory/droids/ and run through the Task tool; the built-in worker and explorer are the native Task routes. This edition installs no droids.

droid_hooks.claim: Hooks are declared in ~/.factory/hooks.json and .factory/hooks.json with lifecycle events such as SessionStart(compact) and UserPromptSubmit; this edition installs no hook files.

droid_live_probe_20260916.claim: Droid CLI 0.220.0 at /usr/local/bin/droid loaded this repository's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at session start. After install-droid.sh --global --yes --forge=github, install-droid.sh --check passed, and a read-only droid exec probe reported the three Kaola skills (kaola-workflow-finalize, workflow-init, workflow-next) plus the machine-global AGENTS.md carrier.

dsh_cli.claim: The dsh command is the DeepSeek Harness launcher. Profiles live under $DSH_HOME/profiles; headless runs one task and exits; web serves the browser UI; --dump-config and --dump-default-config inspect the composed tree without booting it.

dsh_home.claim: An explicit path wins over $DSH_HOME, which wins over ~/.dsh; blank environment values are ignored. All harness user data derives from that one root.

dsh_instructions.claim: The first request includes user-global $DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md followed by the project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain from the git root to cwd. dsh-base enables this with a 65536-byte budget. The baseline remains until compaction; post-compaction reload is not claimed here.

dsh_skills.claim: Skills are directory bundles <name>/SKILL.md or flat <name>.md with required kebab-case name and description. Default roots in rank order: <project>/.dsh/skills, <project>/.agents/skills, customSkillDirs, $DSH_HOME/skills, ~/.agents/skills. Users invoke with /name; the model loads via the skill tool.

dsh_subagents.claim: The model-facing delegation tool is named subagent by default (subagent_fork is a second instance on shipped profiles). Background, depth, and child model fields follow the live schema. This edition installs no Kaola role profiles.

dsh_live_probe_20260919.claim: DSH CLI 0.1.5-rc.2 (`dsh` on PATH) answered --version, --profile headless --help, and --profile web --dump-default-config. The dumped headless and web trees include dsh-agent-instructions, dsh-skill-filesystem, dsh-tool-skill, and dsh-tool-subagent (toolName subagent and subagent_fork). A hermetic DSH_HOME install of this edition writes skills plus AGENTS.md and support scripts only; user ~/.dsh/.env, settings.yaml, and credentials were not opened.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find named profiles in project `.claude/agents/`, user `~/.claude/agents/`, plugin `agents/`, managed settings, or the current session's `--agents`; managed/session/project/user/plugin precedence remains Claude-owned, and the Kaola installer uses the user directory by default.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: Dispatch with `Agent` and `subagent_type: "<role>"`; installed Kaola profiles pin `model: sonnet`, so omit the per-call model unless the item needs a stronger child.
delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `tools` allowlist carries the role tool boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native alternatives include the full `general-purpose` agent, read-only `Explore` and `Plan`, catch-all `claude`, background or isolated children, and optional agent teams; use only the route whose real capability fits the current item.
delegation_guidance.availability: Inspect the current Agent/Task type catalog and effective precedence. Claude currently permits recursive subagents to its native depth limit, which can be configured by the host; do not infer total child unavailability from one missing custom name.

delegation_guidance.profile_lookup: Find custom profiles in project `.cursor/agents/` or user `~/.cursor/agents/`; a file on disk is not discovery proof, so inspect the live catalog. CLI, App local, and App Cloud are separate hosts. Materialize the selected project explicitly.
delegation_guidance.dispatch_carrier: If the exact Kaola role is present and its materialized profile receipt is valid, call `Task` with the live flat `subagent_type: "<role>"` field and MUST omit the per-call `model`; an exact-binding requirement is a post-resolution assertion, never authorization to populate that field. In a built-in-only enum, omit-model is the parent, not a profile pin.
delegation_guidance.tool_boundary: The named profile's native `readonly` flag carries its write boundary.
delegation_guidance.native_routes: Inspect the live Task catalog. Measured hosts exposed writable `generalPurpose` and host-specific built-ins; some hosts document scoped `Explore`, `Bash`, or `Browser`. Use only a route this host reports, under its real identity and capability.
delegation_guidance.fallback_search: If the exact name is absent, first distinguish an uninstalled or unsaved host carrier from a capability gap. Then inspect real alternatives for this item; a miss that the item's brief cannot absorb inlines only that item and records the specific `capability_gap`.
delegation_guidance.availability: The live Task catalog is authoritative; CLI profile reload requires a new process.

compact_protocol.pending: none — Cursor recovery is one persistent Rule, not a hook state machine.
compact_protocol.session: One V2 Rule contains the global contract, operation reload route, mandatory dispatch contract, and Cursor adapter; local installs use the user carrier while Cloud materializes the same bytes in the selected project.
compact_protocol.reload: Cursor includes alwaysApply Rules in every model context. V2 therefore completely reloads Workflow Next or Finalization after compact on CLI, App local, and Cloud even though Cloud lacks sessionStart and preCompact cannot inject context.
compact_protocol.tool: No preToolUse or postToolUse prompt-lifecycle hook is installed; ordinary tools add zero Kaola recovery context and start zero Kaola recovery subprocesses.
compact_protocol.stop: No stop prompt-lifecycle hook is installed.
compact_protocol.fast: Fast is prohibited for named Kaola dispatch and cannot override the profile's pinned model and effort.
compact_protocol.Explore: Built-in Explore is a truthful read-only route only when the live Cursor catalog exposes it; it cannot impersonate a missing Kaola role.

delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native routes are full `general-purpose` and read-only `Explore`, reached through automatic selection or `@`; foreground/background choice remains runtime-owned, and optional call fields follow the live Agent schema — the live schema wins.
delegation_guidance.availability: Children follow the main Agent's model. Subagents cannot spawn children, but the root runtime's other native routes remain available. Compact recovery reloads the operation prompt through ZCode's native Skill invocation — `/kaola-workflow-next` or `/kaola-workflow-finalize` emits a fresh Skill tool call after compact and loads the full body — never a manual `read` of the skill file.

compact_protocol.pending: none — Issue #1044 installs no ZCode prompt-lifecycle hooks, and #1079 adds none: recovery is one persistent managed instruction region plus native Skill re-invocation, not a hook state machine.
compact_protocol.session: The user-global ~/.zcode/AGENTS.md managed region contains the global contract, operation reload route, mandatory dispatch contract, and ZCode adapter.
compact_protocol.reload: ZCode's AGENTS.md prefix survives compaction (KPR #75), so the managed region stays in context and routes recovery to a native `/kaola-workflow-next` or `/kaola-workflow-finalize` Skill invocation, which emits a fresh Skill tool call and reloads the full prompt after compact; never a manual `read`.
compact_protocol.tool: No PreToolUse or PostToolUse Kaola hook is installed, so ordinary tools add zero Kaola context and start zero Kaola subprocesses.
compact_protocol.stop: No Kaola Stop hook is installed.

delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native routes follow the live schema: measured sessions expose `run_subagent` / `read_subagent` with session-start profiles, or the Fusion `sidekick` route. Use the route actually exposed; do not invent profile or model arguments for a different session mode.
delegation_guidance.availability: The profile catalog is fixed at session start. Rules may drop after compaction, so the single UserPromptSubmit carrier reloads the global contract and Devin adapter before routing continues.

compact_protocol.pending: none — one hook reloads the static global carrier after rules drop during compaction.
compact_protocol.session: The global ~/.config/devin/AGENTS.md carrier contains the workflow contract and host-guarded Devin adapter.
compact_protocol.reload: Exactly one UserPromptSubmit hook in ~/.config/devin/config.json reloads the global carrier for routing and compact recovery.
compact_protocol.tool: No per-tool Kaola hook is installed.
compact_protocol.stop: No Kaola stop hook is installed.

delegation_guidance.native_routes: Native routes follow the live Task schema: the built-in `worker` (general-purpose, all tools) and read-only `explorer` routes run in their own context window, plus any user-defined custom droids from ~/.factory/droids/; background execution and resume remain runtime-owned options — the live schema wins.
delegation_guidance.availability: Sibling Task calls run in parallel with their own context windows; a spawned route resolves its model from the invoking route plus the parent's complexity routing and inherits the parent when unpinned, and it cannot spawn further descendants.
